name: Paywall
summary: Wrap a pro-gated affordance; the shared upsell renders itself — crown badge, one-sentence body, the fixed unlock line, and a single Upgrade CTA are baked in.
lead: EVERY pro-gated affordance routes through one element so both products feel like one. You give <aha-paywall> the feature, the copy and the plan; it renders the compliant popover — the purple crown badge (never a generic crown glyph), the one-sentence benefit, the fixed "Unlock with the <Plan> plan." line, and the lone full-width Upgrade CTA. Analytics comes back as events. A hand-rolled upgrade modal/tooltip is the drift this replaces.

spec.label: Crown badge
spec.value: 16×16 purple circle (--aha-color-primary) + white crown — the custom mark, not a Phosphor crown

spec.label: Popover
spec.value: dark indigo surface #242442 (--aha-bg-dark-raised), 300px wide, 16px padding, radius 12

spec.label: Anatomy
spec.value: header (crown + feature label) · body (one sentence + "Unlock with the <Plan> plan.") · footer (single block Upgrade CTA)

spec.label: CTA
spec.value: one full-width primary Upgrade button — no secondary/dismiss button inside the popover

spec.label: Analytics
spec.value: paywall-shown on open · paywall-upgrade before navigation — both { feature, plan }

spec.label: Behaviour
spec.value: CTA opens ahaslides.com/pricing (new tab, noopener); preventDefault paywall-upgrade to run your own flow

props.name: feature-key
props.desc: Stable token (e.g. custom_survey_url) — drives analytics + DOM hooks. Required.

props.name: feature-label
props.desc: Short noun-phrase title next to the crown

props.name: body
props.desc: Exactly one sentence describing the benefit of unlocking; ends with a period

props.name: required-plan
props.desc: Drives the unlock line and the analytics plan prop

props.name: placement
props.desc: Popover side relative to the anchor

props.name: trigger
props.desc: How the popover opens; click-away closes a click popover

props.name: cta-label
props.desc: The CTA verb; override only with a clear reason

props.name: slot (default)
props.desc: The gated affordance = the anchor; omit it to use the crown badge as the anchor

props.name: paywall-shown / paywall-upgrade
props.desc: Analytics contract; paywall-upgrade is cancelable (preventDefault to run your own upgrade flow)

whenToUse.when: any feature locked behind a paid plan — editor affordance, share option, results feature, dashboard action
the feature has no natural clickable anchor (e.g. a field label) — omit the slot and the crown is the anchor
the default gate; use essential only for essential-tier features
a hand-rolled upgrade modal/tooltip drifts from the presenter app — always this element

opinion.note: Feature label is a short noun phrase; body is exactly one sentence about the benefit (not "This is a Pro feature"); the unlock line is fixed — do not reword. Popover/placement mechanics defer to aha-design-overlays; a single plan-gated setting row lives in the Settings surface.

codeNote: One zero-dep custom element renders the shared upsell; the paywall skill's rules (crown-not-Phosphor, one-sentence body, fixed unlock line, single block CTA, the two analytics events, dark-indigo 300/16/12 surface) are baked into its shadow DOM — a consumer can't hand-roll a drifting prompt. The judge/eval + copy voice stay in the aha-design skill.

selfCheck.label: requiredPlan essential|pro drives unlock line + analytics (PAYWALL-07)

conformance.$about: Measured against the RENDERED shadow-DOM UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The first paywall is shown open so the popover is measurable.
conformance.measure: (function(){var s=document.querySelector('aha-paywall[data-probe]').shadowRoot; var g=function(sel,p){var el=s.querySelector(sel); return el?getComputedStyle(el)[p]:null;}; return { popoverBg:g('.pop','backgroundColor'), popoverRadius:g('.pop','borderTopLeftRadius'), popoverWidth:g('.pop','width'), ctaBg:g('.cta','backgroundColor'), crownBg:g('.crown','backgroundColor'), crownPresent:!!s.querySelector('.crown aha-icon[name="system-crown-badge-fill"]'), planLabel:(s.querySelector('.punlock b')||{}).textContent };})()
